title: Restriction of fppf sheafification to the affine site
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $F$ be a presheaf on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site]. Write $u:(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}\to(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ for the inclusion. Then the restriction of the fppf sheafification $F^{\#}$ along $u$ is canonically and functorially isomorphic to the fppf sheafification $(F|_{(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}})^{\#}$ on the affine fppf site.

source.place: Tag 021V, Lemma 34.7.11 (equivalence of the big and affine fppf topoi)

proof.text: By lem-pc-fppf-affine-site-topos-equivalence, the inclusion $u$ is fully faithful, every object of $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ has an fppf covering by affine objects, and every fppf covering of an affine object is refined by a covering in $(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}$; since conversely a covering in $(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}$ is an fppf covering, a sieve on an affine $U$ covers in $(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}$ iff the sieve it generates on $u(U)$ covers in $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$, i.e. the affine fppf topology is the topology induced by $u$. The same node gives that restriction along $u$ is an equivalence of sheaf categories (sets, and likewise abelian groups).

source.place: Tag 021V, Topologies Lemma 34.7.11 (lemma-affine-big-site-fppf) and its proof

proof.text: These are the hypotheses of lem-pc-dense-subsite-sheafification-compatibility for $u$, $\mathcal C=(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}$, $\mathcal D=(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$; it gives an isomorphism $(F|_{(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}})^{\#}\cong F^{\#}\circ u^{op}$ natural in $F$, which is the claim.
